                               SUBJECT(S): Directive, Executive Order, Letter, Memoranda, Rescinded,
ISSUANCE DATE                              GCL 36
 August 5, 2020


  RESCINDS:       Directives 9 of 1969, 20 of 1969; and 15 of 1971
                  Executive Order 1/96
                  Letter 2-26-73
                  Memos 6-23-69, 9-19-69; 10-26-70; 4-8-76, 7-21-76; 10-7-77, 12-28-77; 2-16-78,
                  5-29-78; 8-12-88; and 1-24-90


 The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs),
 Policy and Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various
 Directives, Executive Orders, letters, and memoranda to see if changes are necessary to reflect current
 Department practice and incorporate new laws and regulations.

 Provided above is a list of 3 Directives, 1 Executive Order, 1 letter, and 11 memoranda to be rescinded,
 effective immediately.

 Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. The
 documents will appear on the Department website with the watermark RESCINDED.

 Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in
 future bulletins.

 Watermarked directives, executive orders, letters, and memoranda may be accessed through the online
 version of this Bulletin at
 http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/buildings_bulletin.shtml.




 MELANIE E. LA ROCCA, Commissioner                                                       nyc.gov/buildings
